title: e0vk(2): C DIO receiver wiring — root-sig gate in dodag.c process path (after (1))
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-e0vk. LANDS AFTER (1). Wire into lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio_bytes_authorized (dodag.c:625): scan the DIO options for LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE (0x17) — no option -> process normally (L679); option present -> root_dio_sig_decode + root_dio_sig_verify_structural + verify_signature + root_dio_replay_cache_check_and_admit; signature/replay failure -> reject the DIO; decode/structural/mop failures -> reject. Replay cache instance lives on the dodag struct (root re-election clears it, spec security notes). Host tests: signed DIO accepted, forged rejected, replay rejected.
